specialInstructions: Mouse product names often follow the pattern: Brand + Series + Model (e.g. Logitech G Pro X Superlight 2). Always include the full model name.
Distinguish between wired and wireless variants: 'G502 Hero' (wired) is a different product from 'G502 X' (wireless). Both should get separate entries.
Grip type references (palm, claw, fingertip) are feature evaluations of shape/comfort, not product identifiers.
DPI settings (e.g. '800 DPI') are user preferences, not product evaluations, unless the user is evaluating the sensor's DPI range or accuracy.
Mouse pad mentions alongside a mouse are context, not separate product references.
Weight comparisons are common — 'lighter than my old G502' evaluates weight for the new mouse, not the G502.

wrongProductExamples.scenario: User mentions G502 X Plus but text is about the wired G502 Hero
User mentions a mousepad brand (Artisan, LGG) while discussing mouse glide
wrongProductExamples.reason: Mousepad is not a mouse product
